Please cite the publication of record when using this dataset.
- All water footprint values are in units of m³, carbon footprint values are in units of kg CO2-eq, and water scarcity values are in m3-eq water
- All electricity embedded water and carbon data reflect the operational stage of electricity generation.
- For details regarding the methodology used to arrive at the data, please refer to the publication of record.
- All spatial data is also provided in shapefile format as well.
